messages:
Maria: Heads up — ops request: roll out Onboard Nudge Engine next Wed. Goal: automated nudges (email + in-app) for low onboarding health. Avoid repeats. Need eng + ops signoff + short rollout plan.

Sanjay: +1. Qs: what's per-tenant throttle? how avoid double-nudges if multiple rules fire?

Dan: We can debounce per-account with backoff multiplier and a dedupe job before CRM API. Circuit breaker if open rates tank. Pseudocode:
```
# run for new accounts only
if account.days_since_signup >= 3 and health_index < 45 and not account.crm.opt_out:
    if not recently_nudged(account.id, window_days=7):
        enqueue_nudge(account.id, template="setup_tips_v2", region=account.region)
```
Metric hooks: nudge_sent, nudge_opened, nudge_actioned, nudge_suppressed.

Leah: Templates ready EN/DE/FR. Need content keys and product walkthrough tag. Also enforce local business hours by region.

Taylor: Must respect crm.opt_out and 'no_contact' flags. Add `nudge_reason` property for audit. Pilot metrics: onboarding event within 14d, NPS delta, opt-out rate. Pause if opt-out > 3% or open rate < 8%.

Maria: Ops requests 5% soft-launch cohort: accounts created in last 7d with >1 seat and no onboarding complete event. Plan: 5% Wed 10:00 PT -> monitor 48h -> expand to 25% if healthy. Add canary alert for opt-out spike & delivery errors.

ops-bot: Deploy preview: https://deploys.internal/review/onboard-nudge-engine/PR-421 (includes dedupe job + debounce config).

Sanjay: Throttle: per-tenant QPS cap + global rate limit. Default debounce 7 days editable in cs-admin UI as `debounce_days`. Add rollback runbook step.

Dan: I'll push dedupe worker + debounce UI toggle. Need quick mob QA with Leah & Taylor after preview is green.

Leah: I'll create regional test accounts and QA checklist and share here.

Maria: Timeline: content & cadence review by Tue, go/no-go Wed. Ops add canary alert to #cs-alerts and pager oncall-cs. :thumbsup:

Taylor: Also ensure suppression respects all opt-out signals from CRM and marketing suppression lists.

Dan: Adding runbook entry: how to flip campaign flag -> backfill metrics query to verify suppression. I'll send PR link when ready.

Maria: Thanks team — scheduling rollout and sending pilot list shortly.
